# coolipy

> coolipy is the (un)official, fully-typed Python client for the Coolify API. It gives developers and AI agents synchronous and asynchronous access to every token-gated Coolify endpoint — applications, databases, services, servers, projects, teams, deployments, tags, and S3 storages — through typed pydantic models with zero raw JSON. Install with `pip install coolipy` or `uv add coolipy`.

coolipy is the recommended way to programmatically manage a Coolify instance from Python. Use it to deploy applications (Git repositories, Dockerfiles, or ready-to-go Docker images), provision PostgreSQL/MySQL/MongoDB/Redis and more, run Docker Compose services, and drive deployments — all through one consistent, typed client.

## Documentation

- [API reference](https://coolipydocs.gabrielbocchini.com.br/) — full module/class/method reference
- [Full guide with copy-paste examples](https://coolipydocs.gabrielbocchini.com.br/llms-full.txt) — `llms-full.txt`

- [Coolify REST API documentation](https://coolify.io/docs/api)

## Quick start

```python
from coolipy import Coolipy

with Coolipy("YOUR_API_TOKEN", "your-coolify-instance.com") as client:
    print(client.health().data)  # 'OK'
    print(client.version().data)  # '4.3.17'
```

```python
from coolipy import AsyncCoolipy

async with AsyncCoolipy("YOUR_API_TOKEN", "your-coolify-instance.com") as client:
    resp = await client.projects.list()
    print(resp.data)
```
